Explain how leader election works in the Raft consensus algorithm.

 Thinking Process: 1. Raft decomposes consensus into Leader Election, Log Replication, and Safety. 2. Randomized election timeouts (150ms-300ms) prevent split votes. 3. Candidates request RequestVote RPCs. 4. Detail majority quorum mechanism.

In Raft, leader election uses randomized election timers to ensure a single leader is elected without split votes.

Raft Node States

State Role Transition Trigger
Follower Passively responds to RPCs Election timeout expires
Candidate Requests votes from peers Receives majority quorum
Leader Handles client requests & heartbeats Discovers higher term 
type NodeState int
const (
    Follower NodeState = iota
    Candidate
    Leader
)
